### Fixed
- **An expired token's error reads `token has expired for <server>, re-authenticate to refresh`.** A forwarded or exchanged token that was merely past its expiry ended its error in `%!w(<nil>)`, and the connect log printed `<nil>` as its cause. The message now ends at `re-authenticate to refresh`; a token with no parseable expiry says it is unusable and carries the parse error. ([#1511](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1511))
